items.headline: Tech-stock rout accelerates retreat from the AI trade
items.summary: Reuters reported that the semiconductor index fell as much as 11%, while Nvidia and other large technology stocks sold off as investors reassessed AI-sector valuations, financing conditions and data-center construction risks.

items.headline: Tech-stock rout accelerates retreat from the AI trade
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices was among the large technology stocks falling by double digits during the latest AI-sector selloff, according to Reuters.

items.headline: Tech-stock rout accelerates retreat from the AI trade
items.summary: Micron was among the semiconductor and technology names hit by the broad retreat from AI-linked equities as financing and policy concerns intensified.

items.headline: Tech-stock rout accelerates retreat from the AI trade
items.summary: Qualcomm was cited in market commentary as a catalyst for pressure on technology shares after its outlook missed expectations, adding to concerns around the AI trade.

items.headline: Tech stocks tumble as election rattles AI trade
items.summary: Axios reported that the Nasdaq entered correction territory as investors reacted to a sharp technology selloff and growing concern that the AI boom could slow.

items.headline: Tech stocks tumble as election rattles AI trade
items.summary: The broader technology market weakened sharply, with Axios attributing the move partly to heavy retail selling and post-election reassessment of AI-sector prospects.
